Title: [LSJ] The Coven and different sources of damage

Messages.Author: Damnans

A 2 capacity vampire I control is in combat. The opposing vampire
plays superior Carrion Crows and strikes for 1 hand damage. Could I
tap The Coven after my vampire takes the 1 damage from his opponent's
strike and before taking the 2 damage from the Carrion Crows?

>A 2 capacity vampire I control is in combat. The opposing vampire
> plays superior Carrion Crows and strikes for 1 hand damage. Could I
> tap The Coven after my vampire takes the 1 damage from his opponent's
> strike and before taking the 2 damage from the Carrion Crows?

I'm guessing no.

Your vampires takes 3 damage in strike resolution. Barring any prevention,
you then move on to the healing phase where your vampires need to burn 3
blood to heal damage.
Since he can only burn 2 there will be unhealed damage left and your 2-cap
guy goes to torpor.

I don't think you can choose to burn 2 blood first, then tap coven and then
burn the third blood to end up with 1 blood after healing all the damage.
